methodology.summary: Consumer-staples and healthcare names, ranked on quality and valuation with a technical trend check.
paragraphs: Defensive Consumer & Healthcare is constructed only from the existing Stockmonk US coverage universe. Intended investment horizon: 5+ years. Every selected company passed the strategy's sector, size, liquidity and score-coverage screens.

Eligible US-listed companies are ranked with the Stockmonk four-factor scores: Growth 15% · Quality 35% · Valuation 20% · Technical 30%. Consumer-staples and healthcare names, ranked on quality and valuation with a technical trend check.  The highest-ranked names are selected subject to a 8% single-stock cap and a 55% sector guide. Weights use score-proportional sizing. The portfolio is reviewed quarterly.

No ETF, mutual fund or non-US-listed security is eligible. Missing data is not filled with an estimate. A company without a full research report remains eligible only where the quantitative strategy calls for it, and its constituent card links to score evidence rather than a research report.
The performance shown is a current-constituent simulation, not a live track record. Rebalancing proposals are generated from the same rules and remain proposed until a future review is executed.
